notes.title: Version 1.2 of You Are Liam: Shadow Memories is now live!
notes.content:
VERSION 1.2:
- Nerfed enemy speeds on harder difficulties.

- Nerfed the time it takes for enemies to stop chasing the player after hiding in a closet on all 
  difficulties.

- Updated tiling of a couple of materials.

- Lowered a few password panels that were a bit high on the walls.

- Nerfed Linus doors a bit on all difficulties.

- Updated the look of some elements of the UI.

- Video cutscenes triggered at certain points can now be skipped.

- Added more in-game checkpoints (Checkpoint 8.65 & Checkpoint 25.75).

- Minor changes made to parts of the game scene.

- Other changes/additions/fixes that may not be worth mentioning.

notes.title: Version 1.1 Patch notes
notes.content:
VERSION 1.1:
Updated the normal maps on most materials.
Updated some materials in general.
Nerfed Linus door difficulty a bit on all difficulties.
Added flashlight cookie.
Random jumpscares don't happen as frequently.
Fixed volume of "Fourth Heart" track not changing based on Music volume.
Fixed up one of the randomized passcode puzzle notes missing a letter.
Lowered the minimum value for the mouse sensitivity.
Nerfed car chase speed a bit on Liam difficulty.
Fixed back of Liam models' heads in Extras menu being invisible.
Fixed soft-lock where on rare occasions when holding a letter and pressing E to close it, it causes the drawer it's in to close and the player is then unable to pause the game or continue on.
Other changes/additions/fixes that may not be worth mentioning.

notes.content:
All achievements are now fixed. 

- Upon starting the game, achievements can now be unlocked as you progress throughout the game.
